snippet.title: Little Girl On Earth Asking Why She Asking Why - LAUNCH TRAILER
snippet.description:
"Life sometimes feels like it’s going in circles. The little girl on Earth tells herself this, forever."

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4426850/Little_Girl_On_Earth_Asking_Why_She_Asking_Why/

Little Girl On Earth Asking Why She Asking Why is a very short pixel art Visual Novel, about a girl who has a lot of questions to ask you.
 Answer her questions and make her feel more alive.

(don't be too rude with her please)

This game is a constant questioning of existence itself.

This experience will take only 10-15 min of your life, and for a game with this style and crazy original soundtrack....it's worth your time.... no?

Thanks to everyone who takes the time to play !
